1.critic_justification: The WearableActivity explicitly binds a microphone icon button to viewModel.recordVoice(), which initiates audio recording and streams the base64 encoded audio to maveSessionManager.sendAudio. This confirms user-initiated audio collection.

3.critic_justification: MainActivity explicitly launches Google and Apple sign-in flows which transmit user account information to Firebase Auth. This is initiated via AuthSideEffect events triggered by the ViewModel, confirming user-initiated collection.

4.critic_justification: MyApplication.onCreate() unconditionally plants a CrashlyticsTree for non-debug builds without any prior user consent or UI gatekeeper, confirming silent background transfer of performance diagnostics.
